tei:div.tei:p: (457)༄༅/ snying thig gsol kha'i gtor ma'i zhal khrid/

ma mo 'khrug skong la/ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng*/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma pad 'dab can/ srog chags mdangs sam gzugs brnyan/ dkar mo lag g.yas/ sha khrag snying sna mdos kyi brgyan no/ g.yu sgron ma bshos bu lto ldir dkar po 'khor rang 'dra mtheb ril can/ dur khrod lha mo/ dmar gtor zur gsum bshos bu dang*/ mtheb skyu re res bskor/ ra lug rta bong sha khrag gis brgyan/ tsi'u dmar la/ mkhar gru bzhi/ kha bad can dmar po'i steng*/ gru gsum bdun nam gcig gcus can/ rmang du gru gsum bdun nam grangs med/ rtser 'ug pa dang*/ yungs dkar 'dzugs/ mgon po legs ldan lcags mkhar gru gsum bzhi pa kha bad can gyi steng du/ dpal bshos gru gsum/ gri ris kyis mtshan pa/ mdun du yum bshos gru gsum pa dang*/ rtsa bar gru gsum bcu'am bdun/ mtheb skyu gang mang gis bskor/ sha khrag gis brgyan cing*/ sku rten tsaka li dang*/ mda' bya rgod ma dar nag gis brgyan pa btsugs/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor dpal bshos gru gsum gri ris can gyi mdun du yum gyi bshos bu dang*/ g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab 'khor gyi bshos bu bzhi dang*/ mtheb skyu ci mang gis bskor/ sha khrag gis brgyan/ gnod sbyin bshos bu rtse rgyal la bshos bu zur gsum bzhi dang*/ tel pa bzhis phyogs bzhir bskor ba'i mtshams su (458) mtheb skyu dang*/ nya bos brgyan/ dbus ma'i rtsar dgra bo'i nya bo bting dug pa'i gzugs sha khrag gis bris pa bsham/ srog sgrub la/ ma mo'i dpal gtor mtheb skyu bskor ba/ sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan/ zab mo yang tig skong gsol dngos grub char 'bebs la/ dpal gtor mtheb skyu sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba'i g.yas su gza' yi bshos bu dgus bskor/ g.yon dam can gyi bshos bu mkhar thabs btsan bshos ra skyes kyis brgyan/ ༈ spyi gsol dpag bsam ljon shing la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i zlum gtor mtheb skyus bskor ba dang*/

dpal sngags kyi bdag mo'i dpal gtor mtheb skyus bskor ba dang*/ dpal srog sgrub nag mo chen mo'i dpal gtor mtheb skyus bskor ba dang*/ gza' yi bshos bu dgus bskor ba/ klu brgyad ril bu brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ dmar nag gi bshos bu gru gsum tel pas mtshan pa dbus dang*/ phyogs bzhir bkod pa'i zur bzhir bshos bu zur gsum bzhi dang mtheb skyus mtshan pa dang*/ dam can gyi bshos bu mkhar thabs ra dang btsan bshos bzhis mtshan pa dang*/ bod kyi dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ brtan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa yul lha gzhi bdag spyi'i zlum gtor gcig sgang gnyis legs pa ji ltar 'byor pa bsham/ dkar dang dmar gyi thig dang*/ dar dang zab kyis brgyan no// dge'o//
